impact: Material two-sided injury update; Ashlock is a significant Hawaii offensive negative while Prongos is a meaningful Stanford protection negative
modelTreatment: Do not invent offsetting point values. Keep the Stanford -2.5 fair line unchanged but downgrade Hawaii from conviction-stage to high-priority research because the new information raises uncertainty around the prior 2-point edge.
